**In one line**: Tech stocks tumbled and Dow futures slipped ahead of a Fed meeting after reports that Anthropic is leading a call to slow the pace of AI development.

### Key points
- Anthropic reportedly leads a call to slow the pace of AI development.
- Tech stocks tumbled following the news.
- Dow Jones futures fell, signaling weaker risk appetite.
- Caution was compounded by an upcoming Federal Reserve policy meeting.

### Why it matters
When one of the frontier AI labs signals it wants to ease off the accelerator, markets can read it as a cue to reassess the AI optimism that has propped up tech valuations. Paired with a looming Fed decision, that mix can drive near-term volatility.
